gate.initial_reference_config_note: the initialisation reference is a state saved by the batch-8 probe under that run's own config; it shares the model, LoRA structure, frozen view and train-only statistics with this run, and its own config hash is published separately rather than forced to equal the checkpoints'
gate.noise_set_note: every checkpoint was scored on identical per-window noise draws, so a curve movement comes from the weights and not from the sampling
